additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE concerns the exact gift questions; it neither authorizes pruning the separate claims nor establishes overall candidate correctness.

Scope placement changes answers. With distributor status true, offering false and no conflicts, node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 and node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b return FALSE, while node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e returns OUT_OF_SCOPE. Promotional scope creates similar differences elsewhere. Unknown scope can also block an answer despite a known discount. The intended interface distinction remains unresolved.

The offer-level candidates separate offer-level promotion from the existential gift component. Unless the supplied facts connect the same gift component to the qualifying promotion, unrelated components could jointly produce an unsupported prohibition.

The circular defines distributors as intermediaries distributing SFC-authorised funds, while paragraph 10 uses investment-product language. Candidates with broader actor definitions or narrower product definitions need reconciliation with that context; their equivalence is not established.

Paragraph 9 preserves possible gift classification of guaranteed returns and incentives. Neither their existence nor structured-product status automatically determines gift status. These classifications remain supplied judgments rather than implemented determinations.

node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b's assertions about funding, fulfilment and attribution exceed what the circular expressly resolves for third-party arrangements. Offering need not await payment, but attribution still requires evidence.

Independent verification of the gift standard requires the missing Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC FAQs issued on 30 September 2010, identified by footnotes 2 and 3. Can their applicable versions be supplied? No external dependency IDs are available.

Independent verification of the incorporated advertising standards requires the missing Code of Conduct paragraph 2.3, Advertising Guidelines Applicable to Collective Investment Schemes Authorized under the Product Codes, and applicable FAQs and supplementary guidance referenced by footnote 4. Can those versions be supplied? The narrow extracted advertising duties are nevertheless explicit in the circular.

The advertising duties retain the services and return-presentation context in paragraphs 3 and 15–16. They do not prohibit every mention of positive or guaranteed returns. The deposit-parallel claim captures only one of paragraph 17's advertising duties.

No concrete applicability interval is supplied. The candidates' temporal wording and runtime uncertainty policies do not establish legal effective dates or applicable versions of external authorities.

Passing the selected gift control or returning FALSE for gift prohibition establishes neither overall regulatory compliance nor permission under section 103. Separate statutory and advertising duties must not become additional gift conditions.
